subject.title: fix(discord): pass session file to plugin slash commands

question: Should Discord native plugin command dispatch use the transcript facade before merge, or may this PR add direct session-store/file-path coupling during the session storage migration?
rationale: Repository policy treats session storage and plugin command context as compatibility-sensitive, and the current diff duplicates a transition-only storage path that has a sibling facade.

options.title: Require transcript facade
options.body: Ask the contributor to replace the direct session-store calls with `resolveSessionTranscriptLegacyFileTarget` and refresh proof.

options.title: Accept temporary exception
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the direct file-path coupling as a short-lived storage migration exception.

options.title: Pause the draft
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until both the storage-layer revision and real Discord proof are supplied.

recommendation.title: Require transcript facade
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to replace the direct session-store calls with `resolveSessionTranscriptLegacyFileTarget` and refresh proof.
